_comment: Migrations renamed after they shipped: { "<new filename>": "<old filename>" }. A database that recorded the old name records the new one at boot instead of running the file again (db/migrate.js, recordRenamedMigrations). The old row is kept, for traceability. Append-only. Lives beside the .sql files so the Docker image and the portable bundle (which copies this folder) both ship it.

_gaps.102: Intentionally unused: it held a feature that was removed before it shipped (survey templates). A database that ran it keeps the tables until they are dropped by hand; nothing reads them. Do not reuse the number.
